purpose: Estimate how often manipulation-atlas forms occur in non-sacred texts of comparable genre, period and institutional setting before promoting similar forms in sacred texts.

controls.source: Code of Hammurabi, L. W. King translation / Yale Avalon surface
controls.why: tests divine legitimation, royal titulary, law authority, reward/punishment and curse formulas outside scripture
tests genealogy, divine favor, enemy labeling, victory narrative and truth/lie authority claims in imperial inscription

controls.locus_plan: royal self-presentation + battle narrative + divine aid passages
controls.why: tests victory inflation, heroization, titulary, divine legitimation and monumentality in state text

controls.source: Neo-Assyrian royal inscription/annal corpus via scholarly open corpus candidate
controls.locus_plan: one frozen campaign account selected before technique scoring
controls.why: tests enemy dehumanization, terror display, victory framing, divine sanction and court chronicle selection

controls.locus_plan: historical prologue + loyalty clauses + divine witnesses + blessings/curses
controls.why: tests authority, covenant-like structure, oath, blessing/curse and loyalty enforcement in explicitly political treaty genre

controls.locus_plan: one complete speech/dialogue frozen before scoring
controls.why: tests fear, honor, social proof, false dilemma, ethos/pathos and war rhetoric outside sacred canon

controls.locus_plan: full inscription or frozen thematic blocks
controls.why: tests self-presentation, selective memory, public benefaction, authority transfer and manufactured legitimacy

controls.source: Instruction of Ptahhotep or comparable Egyptian wisdom instruction
controls.why: tests moral exhortation, authority, repetition, hierarchy and pedagogy without assuming propaganda

admission_requirements: exact edition/manuscript or scholarly corpus identity
comparison_rule: A sacred-text technique may not be called unusual or specifically manipulative merely because it is present. Compare its rate/form against relevant non-sacred controls and attack genre/institutional alternatives first.
flood_blind_firewall: This deck and its future results must remain hidden from Flood Coder A/B until their independent 28-feature receipts freeze.
